summary: Contract/freeze phase only -- no Runtime Context implementation, persistence implementation, or execution capability introduced; no file under src/pcae/ touched. Second phase of the 112-series. Freezes the canonical Runtime Context contracts 112A designed: exact immutable identities, state models, ownership, persistence expectations, relationships, and invariants for every one of 112A's twelve Runtime Context objects, before any Runtime Context implementation begins. Adds a new principle, Identity precedes state: a Context object's identity must be frozen before its state contract is meaningful, since Created (112A) is the act of identity assignment itself, not a step preceding it. Freezes twelve identity contracts (session_id through rollback_id, plus RuntimeContext's explicit non-identity as a root aggregate scoped to the active RuntimeSession), each specifying uniqueness, immutability, lifetime, and ownership, grounded in two real precedents (task_id's YYYYMMDD-HHMM-slug format, phase_id's bare identifier format) without inventing new ones; session_id is named honestly as not yet a concrete field in the real .pcae/session.json. Freezes one canonical six-stage state contract (Created, Initialized, Observed, Updated, Completed, Archived) shared by all twelve objects, with valid/invalid transitions, a terminal-state rule, and per-object reachable ceilings today. Freezes per-object ownership (creates/owns/updates/archives/observes), extending 112A's category-level split so no Plugin, Broker, or Registry ever creates or owns a Context object. Refines 112A's persistence model into four buckets (Persistent, Session-only, Future persistence, Never persist) for all twelve objects, sharpening 112A's shared session-only/ephemeral wording for Broker Decision and Observation state into distinct buckets grounded in 109D's already-frozen produced-and-discarded evidence. Resolves the relationship chain's Approval/Broker-Decision ordering to Intent to Broker Decision to Approval to Evidence to future Execution to future Audit to future Rollback, citing 110A section 5's frozen Decision Pipeline to Approval interface and 110A section 8's frozen state sequence. Freezes nine invariants: 112A's seven, with Phase belongs to one Task resolved into at most one Task is active per Phase at any given moment (reconciling cumulative lifetime cardinality with concurrent-moment cardinality as two different, both-true axes), plus two new invariants -- Broker Decision precedes Approval and Identity is immutable and precedes state. Both findings 112A explicitly deferred are resolved here with cited evidence, not assumed by default. Added docs/PCAE_RUNTIME_CONTEXT_CONTRACT.md, docs/PHASE_112_RUNTIME_CONTEXT_CONTRACT_FREEZE.md. docs/ROADMAP.md evaluated and found to need no change. 143 new tests (tests/test_runtime_context_contract.py), a pure documentation-verification suite. Focused tests (1136), governance/autonomy group (2609), and the release/lifecycle regression subset actually present (1429/1429, excluding the two known-slow phase85/phase87 integration files) all passed under -n auto; fast_green 4390/4390 (matches documented baseline).
